verdict.rationale: Alloy documents configurable workflows that apply policy logic to transactions and events, with use-case tags, Portfolio scheduling, and Source Workflow results in an evaluations[] array. It also markets real-time risk signals, a single view of fraud risk, and auditable automation. These give a configurable risk-decisioning surface, but the evidence never describes configuring customer risk factors or a customer risk score, and never explains why a score changed. The services/warnings objects cover vendor execution status and missing data, not score attribution. Missing for 10: explicit customer risk-factor configuration, risk score model documentation, score change history or explainability view, independent corroboration.
